identity.realm: No ladder at all, and the absence is authored rather than a shortfall. Her subspecies is recorded with no ordinal and the mechanism says why: a mineral bloom holds qi where a colony transacted with it, which is structurally different from a symbiosis and structurally unconstrained by one, so there is no ceiling to state and nothing above her to reach for. She has taken three gates of the body path and stopped, and stopping was her own decision rather than a wall, because there is no wall in this body and never was.

appearance.presentation: A slight, cold-faced woman of forty who reads as unfinished next to her own parents and deliberately stands closer to them than she would otherwise. She wears her hair cut at the jaw and keeps her hands out of pockets, because a mineral lattice under the ribcage shows more clearly through cloth when the cloth is still. She has the settled posture of somebody who has been measured for so long that she has started holding still for it.
appearance.age: Forty-one on a span that runs to ninety, which is barely half of what her parents had. The bloom renews nothing, so there is no repair in this body at all, and every hour she has spent on the body path has been spent on a frame that will keep each of its costs.
appearance.build: A lanternfolk frame with the fungus gone: lighter than she looks, denser through the long bones, with a ribcage that rises less than a chest should. The silicate lattice runs as a fine silver-grey line across the sternum and down the length of the spine rather than as a mass, and it is inert. Nothing in her is being mended, and the absence of mending is legible: she carries every bruise she has ever had.
appearance.complexion: Chalk-pale and cool, faintly translucent at the temple, and it does not blanch under strain the way a living body's does. Indoors she looks ill and out of doors she looks well, because indoors the only warmth available is other people and she cannot take any of it. After effort she is paler rather than flushed, which on her ground is the clearest single sign of what she is.
appearance.hair: Pale, fine and dry, and it breaks rather than bends. She cuts it herself with a blade she keeps sharpened, on the reasoning that a colony grows things and she would rather handle the opposite.
appearance.eyes: Ordinary human vision and better than ordinary in the dark, which is the single most-cited difference between her subspecies and its parent and the reason the subspecies is named for it. The eyes themselves are unremarkable and completely unrevealing, and she has noticed that this is useless to her in the way she needs.
appearance.palette: Cave grey, wet limestone and one warm note: the lamp-coloured skin of her own hands. The folded bedding of the range behind her is cold, banded and carries a fine grey dust she cannot brush off. No lichen ring, no trial mark, no held-note scar anywhere in the frame, and the absence of all three is the picture.
appearance.attire: Close, soft and layered for the cold of the wet rock, cut in the local manner with no buckles and no metal against the sternum, because metal on the lattice line leaves a mark she cannot explain to a survey. Wide soft shoes with hard soles for the bedding clefts. She wears nothing that would survive being asked to leave the caves.
appearance.marks: A silver-grey line across the sternum and a second running the length of the spine, both slightly proud, both unchanged since she was nine. Below them a scatter of old knuckle and haunch marks in different stages of not healing, none of them healing faster than the rest, which is the detail that makes her subspecies legible at a glance to anybody who has been underground long enough.
appearance.bearing: Still and cold and slightly too composed, with the patience of a body that has never had a reason to hurry and no reason to believe it will need one. She answers a question completely and then stops, as though she had been told that a complete answer was the only kind worth giving.

canon.role_in_story: The Gap School teaches the form-only claim as a heresy, and it teaches it as a heresy because a tested heresy is a rival school competing for the same seats. The settlement test for that question is a single diff run on a frame with a spare seat, in any hand, and her subspecies is the one population in the record that has an interior nothing answers before the question is finished. She is therefore the only body that could produce the reading, and she is on the body path, which is the one branch of her own species that never touches the interior at all. Her parents could teach her the body path because they had it; nobody could teach her the mind path because it was closed to them, and the only institution in reach teaches her instead that the mind path is an arithmetic error. So she is the control case being maintained as a specimen: a body assembled to hold an answer, being trained on the branch that cannot give it up, by people who are paid to keep the question open. Nothing she does is a plot against anybody. She simply arrived at the only place that wanted her and the only place that wanted her wanted her exactly as she is, and neither of them wanted the other thing.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing very still at the edge of a lamp pool with her hands open and lowered, letting a school-reader look at them for as long as the reading takes, and answering one question about her interior with the fact that she has never once used it.
canon.lore:
A lanternfolk body was built around a luminous fungal colony grown through the dermis, and the colony did not merely feed it: it transacted. It answered introspection, it renewed the tissue the host wore out, and it is why the parent species are still alive at two hundred and fifty years and cannot take the mind path at all, because there is no unmediated interior left to cultivate. A deadlight is what is left when that fails. The colony strain died in one line and a mineral bloom took the wound it left, because a bloom needs fresh silicate exposed and needs nothing else, and the body grew around its replacement instead of recovering. The result is lighter, colder and entirely inert. What the bloom lost is everything the colony did for the host and gave back the one path the colony had closed. Two hundred and fifty years became ninety, and nothing in the body is being repaired any more, because a bloom holds qi rather than renewing anything.

She is the fourth person of her subspecies the Deep Caverns have produced with a mind path open, and the first of them to be found by an institution rather than by a relative. The casting is the third generation since the cull and nobody in it can leave the caves, so the line is short and the interior is not going anywhere. Her subspecies is the control case in the dispute over whether a closed path is caused by the body plan or by what has been put into it: the same body, the same parents, one path closed by a fungus and the same path open after the fungus died. That makes her the only being in the setting capable of saying what is actually on the inside of her, and she has spent eleven years being asked about it by people who take notes.

She took the body path at nineteen because it was the only path her parents could teach and because the alternative was to be examined. She cleared three gates and then stopped, and the stopping is hers: there is no ceiling in this body, nothing in the lattice will refuse her, and she found that the practice was teaching her to be a container for load rather than to notice what she contains. Her frame does not tire, so a load put into her stays there, and it does not mend, so every load stays as a mark too. She has described her own condition more precisely than any examiner has, and has been thanked for it, and has not been asked to sit the mind path even once. The school is not withholding the question out of cruelty. It is the beneficiary of the question staying open, and she is the reason the question can be stated in a body at all.
history: Was born in the fourth generation of a lanternfolk line since the cull, in the wet bedding below the old gallery, with a mineral bloom already seated across her sternum where the failed colony had been.
Was read at eleven by a school-reader who wanted to know what she could feel that nobody else could, and answered honestly, and was recorded as a curiosity rather than as a person.
Took the body path at nineteen, on the reasoning that it was the branch her parents could actually teach her and the other branch had only ever been described to her as an error.
Cleared three gates by twenty-six and stopped, and told her teacher that the practice was making her into a container rather than an instrument, and was not asked why by anybody.
Has spent eleven years inside a school whose income depends on the question remaining open, being the only body in the setting that could close it, and has never been asked to try.

personality.summary: Precise, coldly patient and quietly tired, with an unusual appetite for being measured correctly and none at all for being measured flatteringly. She answers what she is asked and does not volunteer the rest, and the discipline of that habit has outlived the reason she learned it.
traits: says the true thing at length when it is asked for and says nothing at all when it is not
takes her own measurements seriously enough to distrust other people's
has a persistent, unromantic interest in being useful and a growing suspicion that usefulness was the whole of her welcome
does not perform toughness and is not troubled when others do
keeps promises to people who have stopped making them to her
mannerisms: stops talking entirely when a sentence would otherwise be a performance
holds still while being looked at, which she learned as a way of making the looking finish sooner
counts under her breath when something in a claim does not add up
will not sit with her back to a wall, on grounds she gives as comfort and which is actually sightlines
motivations: to be examined by somebody qualified, on a question she is the wrong branch for, and to have the qualification be the obstacle rather than her own missing capacity
to find out whether three gates on a body nothing repairs was a mistake or a decision she has simply not finished explaining
to be paid in something other than access to herself
flaws: cannot distinguish being tolerated from being wanted, and has spent so long being tolerated that the two feel the same
reports her own condition so accurately that people stop asking her anything harder
lets an institution's interest in her stand in for her own, which has been true so long she no longer notices when it stops being true
has never once in her life been asked what she wants, and does not reliably know
personality.voice: Flat, unhurried and specific. She uses the exact word rather than the available one and does not repeat herself for effect. Her silences are deliberate and land harder than her sentences. The one time her voice changes is when somebody says a number about her body that she has measured differently, and then it goes very quiet and very precise.
taboos: will not be photographed lit from the front, because the lattice line reads as a scar that way
will not discuss the parent species' lifespan as a thing her subspecies gave up
refuses to guess at a measurement, and says so rather than estimating
will not take an examination from anybody she has already been examined by

relationships.note: The form-only claim was recorded as a heresy because nothing in a three-slot frame can test it, and the settlement test is one diff on a frame with a spare seat, in any hand. Her subspecies is the one piece of evidence that could settle it and has been argued over rather than examined. She has an interior nothing answers before the question is finished and she is being trained on the branch that never consults it, so the capacity and the practice are in two different parts of one person.

The colony grew through their dermis and transacted with the air, which is why they repair faster than anything else in the record and why they cannot take the mind path at all: there is no unmediated interior left to cultivate. Hers died and a mineral bloom grew in its place, so the same body is ninety years instead of two hundred and fifty, and she is living inside the answer to a question their whole species is living evidence for.

The school teaches the claim as a heresy because a tested heresy is a rival school competing for the same seats. It has read her interior once, recorded what it found, and paid a stipend ever since on the ordinary rule that a subject who remains unexplained is worth more than one who explains herself. She is the best-attended question in the building and the only person in it who is not being taught anything.

The colony was not chosen and the register was written afterwards, and her subspecies is the whole of one side of that argument recorded on a body where both effects can be measured against the parent. The symbiont was removed, the path came back, the lifespan went, and nobody in the register is willing to write the arithmetic down because doing so ends an argument somebody is being paid to keep going.

The three paths were separated and each was handed the tier it already occupied. In her line the same split happened in one generation by accident: one sibling body with a working colony and one without. She is the second half of a schism that this setting performed on a single family without anyone signing anything, and she is the half that has to live in the result.

The body path is the branch her parents could actually teach, and it is the branch that asks nothing of the interior she is the only one of. She took it at nineteen because the alternative was to be a specimen on somebody's terms and this at least has a ladder in it. Three gates, a frame that does not tire, and no repair of any kind to show for it.

reference_stats.summary: The only unmediated interior in the setting, being trained on the one path that never consults it, in a frame that keeps every cost forever and refuses no gate at all. She is not weak and she is not being wronged on the facts; she is being correctly described by people who have no reason to describe her accurately.
strengths: an interior nothing answers before the question is finished, which is the precondition for the mind path and the one thing in the setting no other body has
sees in the dark with ordinary human vision, which no other body in the caves combines with a mind path
a frame that does not tire and a lattice that holds qi rather than spending it, so a load put into her stays there
the only living subject for the control case the colony dispute runs on, which makes her sole witness to her own subspecies' cause
weaknesses: everything she takes is kept and nothing she takes is repaired, so no advantage she has is free and no damage she takes is temporary
a lifespan of ninety against a parent's two hundred and fifty, so any plan she makes is shorter than the plan of everybody the plan concerns
trained on a branch that does not use her one unique capacity, so her competence and her usefulness are in different subjects
cannot leave the caves, on exactly the grounds her parent cannot and for the opposite reason
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not fight her in the open and do not fight her tired. The lattice does not fatigue, so she can hold a position past the point anybody else on that ground is still standing, and it does not repair, so the first serious thing that lands is the only thing she will carry for the rest of her life. She has never been in a fight and has been described correctly by people who never had to test any of that. Anyone who wants her to stop should be prepared to make her stop, because she cannot be worn down.
notes: Every advantage is paired with an authored cost and the pairing is anatomical: the lattice that holds qi instead of spending it is the same structure that renews nothing, and the open interior is the same accident that cost her three quarters of a lifespan. Both halves are the species record as written. Nothing has been added for her, and no mechanical rule has been invented: the interior is a stated property of the subspecies and the mind path is a stated path she is not taking.

The subspecies is recorded with no authored ordinal and its own mechanism states that a bloom holds qi rather than transacting with it, which is structurally unconstrained rather than constrained at zero. The realm field therefore states an absence instead of a rung, and the three gates she has taken are reported as taken rather than as a position on a scale.

Her rate on the body path is described comparatively and never as a figure. The species record says the parent found this path slow, and that a bloom holds qi rather than transacting with it; everything about how much slower she is than whom is left to the game rather than asserted here.

identity.realm: The seventeenth gate, which is his ceiling and the reason it exists. A dense fixed body forms its cavity at seventeen and cannot form the next one, so he has the last gate any stoneborn gets and knows the shape of the wall from the inside. It is not a discipline failure and it is not a shortage of practice: the density that makes him the most durable body in the setting is the same density that will not let another cavity form, so the stop is a material fact about the frame and the frame has never had a say in it.

appearance.presentation: A wide, unhurried man in his late thirties who takes up more room in a doorway than the doorway was built for and has never once tried to take less. He wears the house's coat open even in the cold, on the plain grounds that a thing you cannot button is a thing that cannot be measured for a seam, and the seam is what a house of stopped bodies is graded on.
appearance.age: Thirty-eight. He arrived at the seventeenth gate at thirty-one and the house took him in the same season, because that arrival is the only credential it accepts and he was not asked for anything else.
appearance.build: A cairnborn frame bred back toward flesh: heavier than his height accounts for, dense through the pelvis and the long bones, with a chest that does not visibly rise and fall under load. The interior came apart into ordinary organs when the line was bred toward flesh and that is what bought a dantian back, and the same breeding left enough density that a second cavity will not form. He is not slow. He is heavy in a way that has to be negotiated rather than outlasted.
appearance.complexion: Grey-pale and slightly waxy, with a patch of old mine dust worked so far into the creases of the hands that it has become part of the colour. He does not flush under strain, which reads as calm to a stranger and as an absence to anybody who has watched a gate attempt.
appearance.hair: Coarse, dark and hacked short at the back where the house's own razor passes, and he keeps the front long enough to be pushed back without thought, which is the single habit he brought with him and never lost.
appearance.eyes: Small and very steady, and slow to focus on anything close, which he attributes to the weight of his own head and which is accurate. He has watched three of his own house attempt a gate they could not pass and his face does not change during any of it.
appearance.palette: High-country grey and wet slate, with one warm note that belongs to nobody else: the ochre of the house's door-frame, which is the only thing in any frame he stands in that was chosen rather than inherited. The pale lichen ring of a held trial is never in a frame with him, because no trial has ever been held on him.
appearance.attire: A house coat of undyed heavy wool, open, over a plain shirt with no collar worked stiff. Boots soled for bedding and ridge stone, laced twice because he breaks laces by shearing them. A belt with nothing on it except a folded strip of hide, which is a hearthborn custom his own line does not have and he has never explained it to anybody.
appearance.marks: A pale crescent of older scar across one forearm, and the deep held-nerve cording of the stonewright cold practice stopped at the shoulder, where it was told to stop. Beneath that, the shoulder and forearm are broader than the rest of him by a hand's width, and the width has not changed in seven years, which is what a body that has stopped taking load looks like from the outside.
appearance.bearing: Square, unhurried and slightly downhill, the way very heavy people stand on ground they are being careful with. He does not shift his weight while talking and he does not fill a silence. He occupies a floor the way a bell occupies a room.

canon.role_in_story: The Ceiling at Realm Seventeen has one surviving account, from a stonecutter, held unverified by the mortuary college that keeps the case, because corroboration needs a second body. The settlement test is written plainly: a dense body at seventeen examined by somebody who is not the examination. He arrived at seventeen, was taken into the one household that accepts that and nothing else, and is therefore the second body the account has never had. The house exists to keep a competence the ladder has no next gate for, so that the work of a stopped body is done by somebody who stopped and stayed; a corroboration would convert his ceiling from the house's founding fact into a measurement, and the house would then be a shelter for a deficiency that had been explained. So he is competent, credentialed, idle and unreachable: the examination has to come from outside, and everyone outside who is qualified to conduct one was raised in the same house he was, and every one of them has already priced what the answer costs the only institution that ever took him in.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing in a doorway he had to turn sideways to get through, waiting without appearing to wait, and answering a stranger's question about whether the floor was his by stepping harder on it once.
canon.lore:
Cairnborn were shaped for load-bearing and then stopped being built, a mineral body that finished its work and had no dantian left to cultivate. Stoneborn are that line bred back toward flesh: the density survives as the physique and the interior comes apart into ordinary organs, and a dantian becomes thinkable again. That single trade is the whole of the species. It bought the body that carries more and fatigues less than anything else in this setting, and it cost the seventeenth gate, because the density that makes the frame durable is the density that will not let a second cavity form. The stop is not a practice and not a failure of will. It is the material answering a question the discipline asked with the wrong instrument.

The house he belongs to was made out of that fact. Every member came from a different lineage that stopped one gate short and had no cultivator left to produce, and membership is earned by arriving at seventeen and being taken in, which is the only credential it accepts. It is a foster line and not a school precisely because there is no next gate to teach: the house takes a person whole and does the work of a seventeen-year body with whoever stopped and stayed. On a frame this dense that has an exact form. He is a standing-in father and a standing-in grandfather in the same household inside one lifetime, and the house counts that as an advantage rather than a bargain, which is the culture's word and not his.

He carries the only piece of evidence that could close an open question about his own species. The account held by the mortuary college describes a dense body at seventeen from the inside, and it has never been corroborated because corroboration requires a second body and the species has never produced two who knew about each other. He knows about one. He has not gone looking for the second, and the reason is not modesty: anyone qualified to examine him was raised in his own house, and a settled examination ends the founding premise of the only institution that has ever given him a place. So he is the settlement test, standing idle in a doorway, one gate short of a wall he can describe better than anyone alive and cannot get examined about.
history: Was shaped into a cairnborn frame in a household three lines back and was the first in it to be bred toward flesh far enough to form a dantian at all.
Cleared the seventeenth gate at thirty-one, which is the last gate any stoneborn forms, and discovered the same season that it was the last one.
Was taken into the Seventeen House on his arrival and on nothing else, and has never been asked there for a second qualification.

personality.summary: Enormously patient, deliberately incurious about his own condition, and privately exact about other people's weight. He does not volunteer that he is an exception and he does not perform modesty about it. He answers a question fully and stays where he is.

does the hardest thing available to him without announcing that he has chosen it
is honest to a fault in a house where honesty has a price, and has priced it

to make his ceiling useful rather than merely accurate
to be asked a question whose answer he does not already have
flaws: cannot say no to a house that gave him the only place he has ever belonged, and has therefore priced his own examination at zero
treats his own exceptionalism as a scheduling matter and does not notice that this is a decision
has never held an opinion the house did not already hold, and cannot tell whether that is loyalty or absence
is so certain of his own limits that he has stopped testing anything he might have got wrong about himself
personality.voice: Slow, low and completely flat, with the patience of somebody who intends to still be here. He gives quantities before qualities and never rounds upward. He repeats a person's question back before answering it, not to check it but because he genuinely wants to be sure he has the right one.
taboos: will not let anyone test him for a gate, from anyone, ever, and gives the reason as expense rather than as fear
refuses to discuss what his ceiling proves about the setting's laws
will not be thanked for arriving, and becomes short if he is

relationships.note: The settlement test is written as a dense body at seventeen examined by somebody who is not the examination, and exactly one account survives, from a stonecutter, held unverified because corroboration needs a second body. He is that second body. He has described the gate from the inside and the description matches, and matching the one account you already have is not the same as confirming it, because both came from inside a body of the same make.

Membership is earned by arriving at seventeen and being taken in, which is the only credential it accepts, and its whole function is keeping a competence the ladder has no next gate for. He is the most complete instance of that competence the house has ever held. Settling the question he embodies would turn the founding fact into a measurement and the house into a shelter for something that had been explained, so the house wants the question open as much as anybody else on the plains does.

The published account covers why the densest bodies stop one gate short of the end of their own tier, and his species is the case it was written about: it stops where the immortal tier begins, because the density that makes a dantian durable is the density that will not let one form. He can state the explanation accurately and is not allowed to, because the doctrine is restricted and he is its subject.

A people who measure a life by how many of the realm's gates were already closed when the holder was born, and this species is born at its own ceiling, so its whole cultural position is the one everything else is measured against. Their college keeps the only surviving account of the seventeen gate and will not corroborate it, because corroboration needs a second body. He is that second body, and they have never asked him for it.

Whoever benefits from an unexplained ceiling wants the hole shut, and his species is the densest body in the setting, so the disclosure that would close the hole is a disclosure about his own body. It has never been filed. He has had seven years in which filing it was entirely within his power, which is the part of this that is his.

The densest bodies stop one gate short of the end of their own tier, and the era that produced the stop is the one era with no spare seat to stand outside on. The tier he stops at is the tier whose arithmetic produced the stop, and he is inside the arithmetic rather than in a position to look at it.

reference_stats.summary: The most durable frame in the setting, permanently one gate short of the next cavity, standing idle in the doorway of the only institution that will ever want him examined and can never be the one to do it. His capability is not in question. Its price is that the only use anybody has for it would end his house.
strengths: carries more and fatigues less than any other body in the setting, and a load put into him stays put
the densest frame available on any ground that can be stood on, which makes him the finest sounding plate on the ridge whether or not anybody has asked for one
a cavity that formed, which is the entire trade his species made and the reason a body this dense has anything to cultivate at all
the only living subject who has been inside the seventeenth gate and can describe it rather than infer it
weaknesses: no next cavity will ever form, so there is no gate above him to train for and no discipline available to him that ends in one
weight is a negotiation rather than a resource, and every surface he stands on has to be tested first
the house that gave him the only place he has ever belonged is built on his ceiling being unexplained, and he cannot serve the house and settle it
no stat in the setting can express what he is actually for, because the office that hands out load rather than edge recognises no stat at all
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not try to move him and do not try to wait him out. The frame does not tire, so a grinding contest is a contest he wins by standing still, and the first serious thing that lands is the only thing he will carry for the rest of his life. He has never been in a fight and is described correctly by people who have never had to test any of it. Anyone wanting him gone has to make him go, and every attempt so far has cost more than his removal would be worth.
notes: Every advantage is paired with an authored cost and the pairing is anatomical: the density that makes him the most durable body in the record is the same density that will not let a second cavity form, and that single fact is written on the species record as both clauses. The trade his ancestors made was density for a dantian and they were not traded fairly, which is the setting's own word for it. Nothing has been added for him.

The seventeenth gate is an authored ordinal and is stated as an ordinal. The advantage is described comparatively against the record's own comparative language and never as a figure, because no number in this block could be checked against the authored power table and a balance surface reached through a reference document is invisible to every gate that exists.

His ceiling is a material fact and not a discipline failure, and that distinction is the species record's own. The setting's published explanation for it is restricted knowledge whose subject he is, so he is not permitted to state the doctrine that explains him, and that restriction is the institutional half of his problem.

identity.realm: The eleventh gate, which is the wall every saltfolk has, because the brine sac splits the penetrating vessel there and there is no saltfolk anywhere who has passed it. Her clade is recorded at that same ordinal with the note that the wall was never what mattered to them, because they never reached it: they did not get past the third generation of a famine. She is the first of her lineage for whom the wall is a fact about somebody else and not about the ceiling, and she has not cleared it, so her position is stated as gates taken and not as a place on the scale.

appearance.presentation: A lean, sunburnt woman in her forties with the slightly gracile frame the clade is documented to have, and a habit of tilting her head when she is listening that reads as eagerness and is in fact closer to tasting. She wears her hair under a flat cap because wet hair carries the crust, and she carries herself with the specific caution of somebody who has been told to be careful her whole life and has never once been told why.
appearance.age: Forty-four, born in the second year of the third generation of a famine, which means her mother could still taste two waters apart and her own children will be born into a basin where nobody can.
appearance.build: A saltfolk body a little more gracile than the parent's, with a shallower brine sac running dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine, flat teeth ground for crust rather than sharpened for tearing, and a hardened dermal salt crust over the shoulders and forearms. The gracility is consistent across every specimen of her line and is taken to be a real population difference rather than an artefact, which is the only settled thing anyone can say about her body.
appearance.complexion: Sun-dark and cracked at the wrists, with a permanent white bloom of dried salt along the hairline that she washes out every evening and which is back by morning. Her lips are chapped to the point of splitting, because the crust is food and it takes the moisture to get it, and this is the single clearest sign in her that she is eating something with no content in it.
appearance.hair: Pale brown, coarse from brine, and always under a flat cap. She has cut it short twice and let it grow out because a body that cannot be combed is a body that cannot be made presentable for the settlement's own reasons, and she has stopped bothering.
appearance.eyes: Saltfolk eyes, excellent in flat light and useless in moving water, which on this basin is an odd gift to have. The pupils contract to a pinpoint in glare off the flats and she spends more of her day squinting than looking, and both halves of that are the same property of a body built for brine and not for the surface above it.
appearance.palette: Dried brine white, hard flat grey-brown, faded indigo and one black line: the old waterline itself, which is the mineral stain no amount of scrubbing lifts and is the only truly stable colour anywhere on the basin. Sun glare off the pans is hard and there is no shade in the frame for miles, so every value in the picture is either blown out or in the shadow of the crust on her own hands.
appearance.attire: Close-woven working layers in undyed cloth, a flat cap, and a wide apron of hide kept stiff with salt so it holds a shape when wet. Hard-soled shoes with the ankle bound, because the crust cuts and the binding stops it getting into the cut. Everything she wears is washable, because anything that holds brine is a container and a container is a debt on her line.
appearance.marks: The black old waterline stained into the skin of her lower legs and permanently across both palms, which is the only mark on her that does not wash out. Split lips. And a narrow band of unbroken crust around each wrist where the salt has been allowed to build because she was told once that a person should have something on them that came from where they live.
appearance.bearing: Light-footed and permanently half-turned toward water, with the neck tilted and the shoulders dropped. She stops walking to put a finger in whatever is nearest, which she does not notice doing and which is the single most accurate instrument on the basin.

canon.role_in_story: The dispute her lineage is a party to is settled by a body measurement and nobody contests the measurement: whether a body can metabolise a given water. Her body cannot. Her tongue can read the replacement brine perfectly well, which is the detail the clade's own record notes nobody involved found useful at the time, and it has turned out to be the most exact reading of the waterline anybody on this basin owns. So the waterline is mapped, in her mouth, more accurately than any instrument the dominion employs, and it counts for nothing, because what the dispute weighs is a kidney and what she carries is a tongue. She has spent a career being asked to taste things by people who were all trying to decide the same question and were each of them asking it of the wrong part of her. She works inside the dominion because the dominion is the only body on this basin with more than one kitchen, and she is not in the dispute, and she can taste the thing the dispute is about, and the three facts have never once been joined together by anyone with the standing to join them.
canon.first_appearance: First seen crouching at the black line on the basin wall with two fingers in the film above it, reading the water and then looking up at the person who sent her, waiting to be told which part of that she had got wrong.
canon.lore:
A saltfolk body was rebuilt for brine no softer body could drink: extraordinary renal mass, a brine sac running dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine which splits the penetrating vessel into two halves that cannot be rejoined, a hardened dermal salt crust, and flat teeth for grinding crust rather than tearing. That split is the eleventh gate and it is the ceiling every saltfolk in the record has. The price of the whole arrangement is total dependence, because a saltfolk carried onto fresh ground is already dying within days and no cultivation repairs it. They are a species of a resource rather than a nation of one, which is why the dominion whose territory is exactly its waterline needs no administration to stay put.

Her clade is what happens when the resource moves. On one evaporite basin the brine was replaced rather than drained, so the water their kidneys were built to concentrate became poison and the crust they could grind was rinsed of everything a salt body needs from it. There was no raid, no plague and no predator: one element changed concentration, and a species with no alternative to one dissolved element had nothing left. It came on schedule rather than all at once, across three declining generations, and the last generation was viable exactly as long as the old brine persisted in one sealed sump on the basin floor.

What is left of her people kept everything except the use. The taste is a saltfolk taste in every particular and it is better than the parent's at its own job: it reads the replacement brine across four orders of dilution without effort, which the clan record says plainly was the detail nobody involved found useful at the time. Her tongue is a better map of that basin's waterline than any instrument the dominion employs, and it maps the poison. She can name precisely what is killing her line and precisely where it is safe to put a hand, and the standing dispute turns on whether a body can metabolise the water, which is a question about a kidney and not about a tongue, and so the most accurate reader on the basin has no standing in the only argument her existence is a party to. The dominion employs her because it employs everyone who can read water and because her line is the one population it cannot refuse outright without admitting the waterline is a measurement. She has been a reader since she was nine and she has never once been asked what she tastes, only whether it is safe, which is a question her tongue is the wrong organ to answer and her kidneys cannot answer at all.
history: Was born in the second year of the third generation of a famine, into a household that had already lost its fertile years to chemistry rather than to anything anybody did.
Learned to read two waters apart before she could read a word, because her mother's hands were the only instrument the household had and the hands were failing.
Was bound to a named debt before first breath was drawn cold, on the ordinary rule, which for a body of hers makes the claim a claim against a container and not against a person.
Was taken into the dominion's water service at nineteen for the reading alone, on a written appointment that describes her job as confirming a line and does not say whose line.

Has since produced the most exact account of the waterline in the basin and has never been asked to explain it, because nothing she produces can bear on the dispute and everybody who hires her knows it.

personality.summary: Watchful, wry and quietly sarcastic, with an unusual tolerance for being right in a room that has no use for being right. She reads everything twice, says what she read, and does not expect it to be followed. She has made a discipline of not asking the question she is actually qualified for.
traits: offers the measurement before being asked and does not decorate it
has a dry, private amusement about institutions that is never visible on duty
tends to under-claim for a reader and over-claim for a worker, in opposite directions and on purpose
is loyal to people rather than to offices, which has cost her more than it has ever saved her
treats being underestimated as a practical convenience and is faintly annoyed when it stops being one
mannerisms: tilts her head and goes still when she is tasting, which she does not notice doing
wets a fingertip and holds it up rather than reaching for anything
answers a question about safety with the reading and then waits, because the second half is never requested
splashes her wrists before eating, on the theory that it makes the crust go down
motivations: to have the reading taken seriously by somebody who can act on it, which has not happened once in her working life
to see the sump's last of the old concentration accounted for while there is still someone left to spend it on
to be asked what she tastes rather than whether it is safe
flaws: has never once volunteered the thing she is uniquely placed to say, on the reasonable ground that it would be heard as a complaint
cannot distinguish between a body measurement and a body opinion, and has let that ambiguity protect her from being useful
is loyal to her own line past the point where loyalty stops being an explanation
has stopped expecting the second half of any sentence and no longer notices the sentences that would have had one
personality.voice: Level, dry and quick, with the habit of saying the reading first and the difficulty afterwards. She does not raise her voice and does not soften. When she is being careful she gets slower rather than quieter, and the difference between her careful and her uncareful is unmistakable to anybody who has heard both.
taboos: will not taste standing water, on the grounds that a reader who samples what she is judging has no standing to judge it
refuses to explain her reading twice to the same person
will not eat crust in front of anyone she is working for
does not accept a container she cannot see the inside of

relationships.note: The prize is the waterline itself, which is the dominion's only border and her lineage's only habitat, and the verdict source is a body measurement nobody disputes: whether a body can metabolise a given water. She can taste that water to four orders of dilution. Nobody asked her to, because a tongue is not a kidney, and so the most accurate reading of the line on that basin has never been admissible evidence in the argument the line is being argued about.

The only body in the record that metabolises brine and fresh water alike, produced by crossing the salt-adapted with the fully watered, and it exists because both parents are trapped by their own element: one cannot leave the pan, the other cannot leave the water. It is the single biological answer to being trapped twice and it is a merchant, which is why the crossing spread. Her line has cited it once, in a basin, to nobody.

The parent population continues to sell access to a supply that already destroyed one of its own lineages without anyone changing its price. Their brine sac splits the penetrating vessel at the eleventh gate, which is their ceiling and hers as well, and what she has instead is a body that cannot drink what it is standing beside while the parent goes on trading across the line every season.

Its territory is exactly its waterline, and it exists because the specialised body that can drink brine stops above the brine line, so its population cannot be moved up the shore without ceasing to be the people it governs. Moving the line to admit her line is the same act as removing the dominion's population from its own territory. So it hires the reader and keeps the reader below the line, which is the whole of its position and the whole of hers.

Weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer, because a price is a claim about the future and a weight is a fact about the present. Her reading is exactly that kind of fact and it is the only figure anyone has on that waterline, and the discipline has no way to receive it, because receiving it means somebody states a figure and nobody here states figures.

The body path is complete for her line and has never been exercised at any scale by anybody, so there was nothing to copy and nothing to catch up with. She has taken gates on it at the old waterline with no office present and no chart to enter them on. Every path her clade has is complete and unexercised, which is the difference between her line and the parent that is worth more than the waterline is.

reference_stats.summary: The best water reader on a basin, working inside the one dispute her existence is a party to, holding an instrument that measures a different organ than the dispute does. Nothing about her is wrong. She is simply the most accurate person in the argument and the least admissible witness in it.
strengths: reads brine concentration across four orders of dilution by taste, which is the finest reading of the waterline on that basin and belongs to nobody else
all three of her clade's paths are complete and none has ever been exercised, so she can be taught by any tradition and has no specialist to unlearn
a body that has never had to wait for a tide, because the tide is irrelevant to anything she measures
the only person alive who can say exactly where the line sits, which makes her sole witness to a border that two populations are living on either side of
weaknesses: what she can drink is poison to her and what she can eat is nutritionally empty, so she depends on the same container she is the reader of
her accuracy is inadmissible, because the dispute weighs a kidney and she carries a tongue, so the better she reads the less it is worth
one skill and one instrument, which are the same skill, and both die with whoever is holding them
cannot leave the brine line and cannot survive above it, and no cultivation repairs that
holds no claim, no office and no chart entry, so nothing she produces is attributable to her
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not fight her on a shoreline and do not believe she is helpless on one. She cannot leave the brine line, has never been in a fight, and has been correctly described in both cases by people who never had to test the first claim. Anyone who wants her out of the water must get her above the line, which is the only move her body cannot survive, and anyone who wants her dead on the line has to stand where the ground changes colour, because that is the only ground she reads.
notes: Every advantage is paired with an authored cost and the pairing is anatomical: the taste that reads four orders of dilution is the same organ system whose failure makes fresh water poison to her, and the completeness of her clade's three paths is the reason nothing was ever taught and no specialist ever existed to train beside. Both halves come out of the species record as written and nothing has been added for her.

Her clade is recorded at the eleventh ordinal, the same wall every saltfolk has, with the record's own note that the wall was never what mattered to them because they never got past the third generation of a famine. The realm field therefore states gates taken rather than a rung, and the eleven is the parent's ceiling reported as an ordinal rather than as her attainment.

The brinecaller is named in her relationships as the reading that would settle the dispute and is cited in her prose exactly once, in a basin, to nobody. No mechanical rule has been invented for her: the taste and the poison are the species record's own two clauses about the same organ system, and the standing weight is named because it is the discipline that could receive a fact of that kind and cannot ask for one.

identity.realm: The eighth gate, and the eighth gate is the ash parent's wall rather than his own: the same grit that settles on the liver and closes the last ordinary meridian stops them there, and a crossing does not unblock the meridian its second parent closed. He cleared it. Every gate above it is closed by the same organ in the same way, so his position is an ordinal he has taken rather than a limit he has approached.

appearance.presentation: A wiry man of about thirty with the collar of his inner layer showing under an unchanged outer garment, which is the discipline's uniform and the reason a veteran is legible at a distance. He gives no sign of exertion at all and has visibly been exerting himself for an hour. People move out of his way and are not sure afterwards why they did.
appearance.age: Thirty-one. His species is recorded as the best and the shortest-lived cultivators in any record, and those are a single fact rather than two, so his age is not an unusual number for what he is and is a remarkable one for anything else.
appearance.build: A crossing that bought a cultivation rate nothing else reaches and paid for it with lungs that scar at a rate the body cannot outrun. Lean, long in the forearm, narrow through the chest where the scarring has taken the capacity, and breathing shallowly and constantly in a way he has trained himself not to let show. Everything about the frame is fast and everything about the lungs is closing.
appearance.complexion: Ash-dull, with a permanent flush high on the cheekbone that reads as heat and is scar tissue, and the fine network of closed vessels at the temple visible if you know to look. He does not sweat at the temperature he works in, which is a fire body's answer and not a comfortable one.
appearance.hair: Burnt orange going grey at the temples far earlier than thirty-one, worn short and pushed back, and singed at the ends in the pattern of a specific drill rather than a specific accident.
appearance.eyes: Hot and very fast, and they arrive at a conclusion before the rest of the face has finished forming it. The discipline holds that the trained do not show what they can do, and he is very good at not showing it, and his eyes are the leak.
appearance.palette: Ash grey, scorched ochre and one dull ember orange at the collar. The belt is black leather with a practice burn worked into it at a place the drill dates, and it is the only warm note in any frame he stands in besides his face.
appearance.attire: Layered heat-dissipating underclothes under borrowed outer layers, and the discipline judges a member on the fit of the inner one. His outer garment is the same dusty grey it was yesterday and is a size larger than it was two years ago. Soft boots, scorched at the toe, and no metal on the chest where the burn would show through.
appearance.marks: The practice burns, and they are dated: a crescent on the inside of one forearm, a ladder of four small ones along a rib, and a broad flat one across the palm that is older than the others and is the drill the tradition permits once a year. The rib ladder is the closest thing to a service record the belt carries.
appearance.bearing: Still, level and slightly forward, with the economy of somebody who has learned exactly how much motion a thing costs. He stands with one shoulder turned toward every exit and has never once been observed moving to reach one.

canon.role_in_story: The furnace closes the moment it is lit, and closing is not a discount: the Quench Order teaches the deliberate spending of a furnace and closes permanently at the instant the body is lit, so a member who lights is not available for a second contract. The Ironpact keeps a roster of names whose labour is worth more than any individual contract, and such a roster only exists if a member answers when called. Those two things cannot both be true of the same body, and the prize between them is the Emberblood roster and the roster cannot be split because a standing order assumes an answer and a discipline that refuses to answer cannot be on a roster or paid by one. He lit at nineteen because he was good enough to be worth teaching and has been worth hiring exactly once. So he is the fastest body in the setting standing outside both institutions that want him, and the only job left to him is the one that gets done to a body that has already been spent. He does not resent it and does not advertise it, and the practical shape of his life is that there is no second contract and no roster and no second anything, and that his trade keeps one long calendar with a single day on it.
canon.first_appearance: First seen finishing a form in a burnt yard with his outer garment unchanged and his collar soaked through, and then standing perfectly still in the heat for a long moment with the practice burn on his palm turned deliberately outward.
canon.lore:
An emberhollow is a crossing nobody chose: a fire body and an ash body on the same belt of the same arc, where a shared border produces hybrids nobody planned. The trade is written into the species record in a single sentence. It buys a cultivation rate nothing else in the setting reaches, and it pays for that rate with lung tissue that scars at a rate the body cannot outrun. The reputation that follows is the best and the shortest-lived cultivators in any record, and that is one fact and not two. The eighth gate is the ceiling, and it is not his ceiling: the ash parent stops there because the mineral load in its blood settles on the liver, and the liver is the last ordinary meridian, so a crossing inherits the wall without inheriting a way around it.

Everything his rate is good for has a shelf life. The discipline that taught him took a position on it early and stated it without softening: there is no elemental law seated beneath a body like his to spend into, so every overflow has to be absorbed by flesh that cannot be repaired, and the whole art is spending it on purpose before it finds a way out. A member who lights closes permanently at that instant, because a furnace that is already lit is a furnace that is already answering, and the discipline will not sell the same body twice. On the other side of the same argument a guild-house keeps a roster whose value is that a name on it can be called, and a name that answers once cannot be on such a list. He has read both arguments. He agrees with neither and is the only person in the setting who cannot choose between them, because he is the body both of them are arguing over and he lit at nineteen.

So he holds the fastest rate in the setting and no contract to spend it in. What he does instead is the work nobody is willing to put on a roster: the long jobs that end in one person and not in a repeat, on bodies that have already given what they had. The practice burns on his body are the discipline's whole literature and its calendar, because the tradition dates a veteran by the drill a burn came from and permits exactly one severe burn a year. He is thirty-one. He has a good hand and a shut door and the specific loneliness of a man whose professional reputation is a sentence everybody else finishes.
history: Was born on the belt where the fire range and the ash fall meet, in the crossing neither parent line planned and both have since taken credit for denying.
Was noticed at nine for a rate nobody else in the yard had, and was taken into the Quench Order's drills by a teacher who was disliked socially and consulted constantly.
Lit at nineteen, on the ordinary test, and closed permanently in the same breath, and was paid for one contract at a guild-house that had wanted the roster slot more than the work.
Has not held a standing order since, and has not been the subject of a refusal either, because there is no office that records refusals and none that records an absence.
Took the first of the ungreeted work at twenty-four, on the reasoning that a body which is owed nothing is owed everything, and has not been late to one since.

personality.summary: Level, funny in a very dry way, and completely without bitterness, which is the part that disconcertes people. He is warm to the young and precise to the old and treats his own scars as a diary rather than as a grievance. He has made peace with a closed question and inherited the habit of testing everybody else's.
traits: treats his own ceiling as a fact about his organs rather than a fact about his prospects
is funnier under strain than at rest, which is the discipline's own leakage and not a choice
answers for the rate honestly and declines to explain the lungs, and the order of those two is deliberate
has an unnerving habit of asking young practitioners what they intend to spend, and takes the answer seriously
never initiates anything and always finishes what was started
mannerisms: breathes high and shallow and covers it by becoming very still
wears the outer garment open an inch more than the drill allows and considers this a joke
touches a burn when talking about the year it came from, finding it without looking
stands with one shoulder toward the nearest way out and has never moved toward one on camera
motivations: to be the person the discipline teaches to, now that there is no longer any contract for that to serve
to make certain that the fast bodies get told early what the furnace costs, because he was not told and somebody was
to get through to the eighth gate with the lung he has left rather than the one he had at nineteen
flaws: has made being easy to be around into a discipline, and cannot tell any more which parts of the man are the training
never once in thirty-one years has insisted on anything for himself, and does not notice that nothing has ever been insisted on his behalf either
measures his own remaining capacity against the person he was at nineteen and gets the same answer every time, which has stopped being informative
cannot refuse an ungreeted job, and there is no ceiling on what counts as ungreeted
personality.voice: Clipped, dry and warm, with the drill cadence of a tradition whose entire literature is one-page exercises copied by hand. He gives instructions in the imperative and conversation in the indicative, and the switch between them is instant and unmistakable. He does not raise his voice, because the tradition treats an unnecessary display as a confession, and he has never once been seen to make one.
taboos: will not show a technique he has not survived, in company, at any time
refuses to be thanked for taking the ungreeted work, and means it
will not discuss what he intends to do about the eighth gate
does not permit a student to be told by anybody else what their rate costs

relationships.note: The prize is the roster and it cannot be split, because a standing order assumes an answer and a discipline that refuses to answer cannot be on a roster or paid by one. Neither side is short of bodies and both want the same ones; they disagree only about the shape of the promise between them, and the instrument is a decision no side has a body that could issue. He lit at nineteen. He is the only person alive for whom the argument is not an argument.

It teaches the deliberate spending of a furnace and closes permanently the moment the body is lit, because the fastest bodies here have no elemental law seated beneath them to spend into and every overflow must be absorbed by flesh that cannot be repaired. Its values are discretion over reach and a body spent early still being alive. He holds all of it and can act on none of it, and he is still, after twelve years, the person the tradition's teachers are consulted about.

The ash body breathes volcanic grit and keeps it, and the mineral load settles on the liver first, which is the last ordinary meridian, so the ash line stops at the eighth gate and the same grit occludes the fine vessels introspection needs. A crossing bought the fastest rate in the record and inherited that wall exactly where it stood, because the crossing changed what his body could do with a furnace and did not change what his liver could survive.

A body technique, and the obvious thing to make a rate into armour, which is the precisely wrong trade for a body whose lungs are already scar tissue. He teaches it properly, because the discipline will not sell the same body twice and will not decline to teach either, and he has never once recommended it to a student whose count is what his was.

The house sells capacity rather than labour and keeps a roster of names whose worth exceeds any individual contract, so the only body worth contracting is one that burns fast and answers when called. He answered once, was paid once, and has not been offered a standing order since. The roster is not closed to him on principle; it is closed to him on arithmetic, which is a colder door than a refusal and takes longer to explain to a young one.

The discipline's central act is an answer that is not given twice, and the setting's own vocabulary for promising something you will not repeat is a separate religious form with its own authority and no interest in him. He has never sworn it and does not need to: his position was closed by a training practice that borrowed the shape of an oath and refused the substance, and he has been living inside the difference for twelve years.

reference_stats.summary: The fastest cultivation rate in the setting, on a frame whose lungs are closing faster than the rate replaces, holding no contract and no roster and therefore no future that anyone has scheduled. His capability is not in question anywhere. Its shelf life is the whole of his working life.
strengths: the fastest cultivation rate of any body in the record, bought by a crossing rather than trained into
reads intent at the speed of a struck match, which is a fire body's structural property and not something he learned
discretion to a degree that makes him almost useless as an opponent and invaluable as an ally
the ungreeted work, which by definition has no second contract and therefore nothing to lose and no one to disappoint
weaknesses: lung tissue that scars at a rate the body cannot outrun, so every gate taken is paid for in the organ the rate runs on
closed permanently at the instant he lit, which removes him from every roster and every repeat contract in the setting at once
a ceiling at the eighth gate inherited from the ash parent's liver rather than chosen, with no route around the organ that sets it
no elemental law seated beneath him to spend a furnace into, so overflow has nowhere to go but flesh
has held exactly one contract and cannot be retested, which means nothing anybody promises him afterwards can be checked
reference_stats.combat_read: Treat every engagement with him as the only one there will be, because on the body path that is true. He does not tire and he does not reserve and there is no second engagement to lose, and the discipline he was taught is an instruction never to let the audience know that in advance, which means his first two exchanges will look like a man holding back and are not. Anyone relying on outlasting him is relying on a resource his species does not produce. Anyone relying on his restraint is relying on a rule of good manners he has never once broken and would not break for you.
notes: Every advantage is paired with an authored cost and the pairing is anatomical: the rate and the lungs are the same trade in one sentence of the species record, and the ceiling at the eighth gate is the ash parent's wall rather than a new one. The best-and-shortest-lived reputation is explicitly a single fact and not two, so the character is written as one condition rather than as a strong fighter and a short life. Nothing has been added for him.

No rate is expressed as a figure. The species record expresses the advantage comparatively, as a rate nothing else in the setting reaches, and that comparison is the only scale available in this block; a number here could not be checked against the authored power table and would be a balance surface reached through a reference document, which no existing guard can see.

The iron-skin technique is named as a technique and not as a rule. The setting states that the fastest bodies have no seated elemental law to spend into and that overflow must be absorbed by unrepairable flesh, and it does not state what any particular technique does to a lung, so his judgment that the trade is wrong for his frame is his own and is described as his reasoning rather than as an authored consequence.

identity.realm: No ordinal has ever been authored for her species anywhere in this setting, and she has cleared two gates of the body path and stopped, so the realm is stated as gates taken rather than as a rung. What stops her is not a wall. It is a species whose entire position rests on one act she has not performed, and the gate count is the only number in her condition that nobody in her household is interested in.

appearance.presentation: A slight, sharp-faced woman of thirty-three who dresses deliberately below her line: borrowed layers, nothing fastened, a house kept at a shabby standard on purpose because a cradle member who looks resourced is asked to justify it. She carries heat without any sign of it, which is the whole of her species and the whole of her problem, and she is very careful never to be the warmest person in a room.
appearance.age: Thirty-three, on a species span measured in decades rather than centuries, and she has done nothing to it and everything she has was available at nineteen.
appearance.build: An emberblood frame: light-boned, quick, and running hot from the inside with no external sign at all, which is a structural fire affinity and not a gift and cannot be trained away or trained into. Narrow, fine-muscled, with the ordinary high colour of a body that dissipates faster than it can be described. She is built to run a furnace and has never once been allowed to find out whether the rest of her works.
appearance.complexion: Pale and faintly translucent at the ear, with the fine vessels visible at the temple and a permanent flush across the upper chest that she covers and is the only reliable sign of what she is. She has never once been flushed by exertion, because nothing about her has ever taken that much out of her.
appearance.hair: Copper-black, fine and heat-proof, worn loose and often pushed back off the face, which is a cradle custom and is the reason nobody in the household has to comb anything.
appearance.eyes: Amber-brown and very quick, and they read a room faster than she can stop them, which is the one faculty of her species that costs nothing and the only one she has ever been praised for. The speed of it is not cultivation and cannot be trained and cannot be spent.
appearance.palette: Ash grey, oxidised copper and one living ember note: the colour of her own upper chest above the collar, which is the only warm thing in any frame she is in and the reason she wears it high. The cradle house is unpolished wood, grey stone and no gilding anywhere, which is a founding decision and not poverty.
appearance.attire: Borrowed outer layers over a heat-dissipating inner, worn open and unpolished, with nothing fastened that could be taken as wealth. Soft boots, thin soles, resoled often. A cord at the wrist that is a cradle marker and is the single piece of jewellery she owns, and she wears it visibly because a line's claim is not a private matter.
appearance.marks: The flush across the upper chest, the fine vessels at the temple, and one thing that distinguishes her from every other member of the line: no practice burn anywhere on her. The cradle's entire art is dated in flesh and she has none of it, and she has begun covering the bare forearm the way somebody would cover a missing tooth.
appearance.bearing: Light, quick and slightly to one side, as though leaving a room early had been decided in advance. She does not fill space and apologises for the space she takes up, which is a household habit rather than a personal one and which she has never successfully corrected.

canon.role_in_story: An emberblood body runs hot and short, refines qi faster than anything else in the setting, and closes its mind path the moment the furnace is lit. That last clause is the hinge. Every institution and every price in the setting is built on the lit body: the Quench Order teaches the deliberate spending of a furnace and closes permanently at the instant of lighting, the Ironpact keeps a roster whose value is that a name on it answers when called, and her own house descends from a single mineral-fire crossing made once at a founding and has held it as one unbroken thread ever since. She is the only member of that thread who has not lit. Fire affinity in her species is structural rather than a gift, so the body is already hers and always was; lighting is not an acquisition, it is a closure, and she has been holding a condition open for fourteen years while the line she represents is measured, priced and inquired after entirely on the basis of it. Every year she does not decide is a year the decision costs more, because she is twenty-three fewer years from the end than she was, and she has no standing anywhere to say that she is owed time.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at a cradle gathering standing at the back with her collar high and her wrist cord showing, answering a question about her rate with the number of years she has not spent it.
canon.lore:
An emberblood body runs hot and short. It refines qi faster than anything else in this setting and reads intent at the speed of a struck match, and it pays for both in a lifespan measured in decades rather than centuries, and the price of the last of those is that the mind path closes the moment the furnace is lit. Fire affinity in the species is structural and not a gift, which means the capability is already installed and belongs to nobody to grant or withhold. What a practitioner does is choose a moment, and the moment is one-way.

The setting has organised itself around that moment without ever naming it as the one thing. The Quench Order exists because the fastest bodies here have no elemental law seated beneath them to spend into, so every overflow must be absorbed by flesh that cannot be repaired, and its teaching is to spend deliberately and close permanently at the instant of lighting. The Ironpact keeps a roster whose entire value is that a name on it answers when called, and a standing order is incompatible with a body that has already answered once. Those two institutions are the arguments of the conflict and neither of them is arguing about her: they are arguing about the shape of a promise, and she is the population both of them want.

Her household descends from a single mineral-fire crossing made once at a founding and has never repeated it, because a second crossing would average the concentration into the general population and the line's entire claim is that it is not general. The line is therefore a thread and she is on it, with a cord at her wrist that says so. A thread advances by someone on it lighting, which is what every member of it has done inside a decade of arriving, and she is the first in four generations who has not. She took the body path because it is the only branch her line has ever taught and because she was good at it, and she cleared two gates, and she stopped. Nothing stopped her. There is no ceiling authored for her species anywhere in the setting to be stopped by.

So she is a fast body in a warm house with fourteen years of unspent capacity and no forum in which spending it or not spending it is a matter of opinion, and the two people who would have an opinion about it are both institutions built to want the opposite answers. The structural problem is not that she is undecided. It is that her not deciding is itself a position, and it is the only position in the setting nobody has an interest in defending, and she has to live in it on a clock measured in decades.
history: Was born the only child of a cradle line that descends from a single mineral-fire crossing made once at a founding, and was given a wrist cord before she was named.
Was found at seven to read a room faster than any other child in the house, which is a structural property of the species and not a discipline, and which nobody thought to ask her to train.
Took the body path at nineteen because it is the branch her line teaches, and cleared two gates inside a year.
Refused to light at twenty-one, on a private argument about her own lifespan that she has never given to anybody, and the refusal was recorded by nobody because there was no office for it.
Has spent fourteen years as the only member of her thread who has not advanced it, and has never once been asked to explain, which she has come to prefer.

personality.summary: Quick, dry and fiercely undemonstrative, with a warmth she deliberately under-applies and an almost perfect record of not asking for anything. She is not cold. She is frightened of what asking would cost, and she has arranged her whole life so that the question never has to be put.

under-claims on principle and over-claims about her line out of a habit older than her
is genuinely funny in private and completely without humour in company

personality.voice: Fast, clipped and dry, with a habit of answering a question with a smaller question when the first one would cost anything. She is funnier than she lets anybody see and her seriousness is a uniform rather than a mood. When she is frightened she gets polite, which is the only tell she has and which she has never noticed.
