will not be introduced as the heir to anything, and corrects people who do it
does not accept a favour from her household, on the grounds that it would have to be repaid in light

relationships.note: A single mineral-fire crossing made once at a founding and never repeated, because a second crossing would average the concentration into the general population and the line's whole claim is that it is not general. It has been held as one unbroken thread ever since and a thread advances when someone on it lights. She is the first in four generations who has not, and the household does not press her, because pressing her would make the refusal a position rather than a delay.

A body that runs hot and short, refines qi faster than anything in the setting and reads intent at the speed of a struck match, at the cost of a lifespan in decades and a mind path that closes once the furnace is lit. Fire affinity is structural, not a gift, so the capability was already hers; what she is holding open is not an acquisition but a closure, and it is the only one of her species's advantages that nobody can observe without her choosing to show it.

The Quench Order teaches the deliberate spending of a furnace and closes permanently at the moment the body is lit; the Ironpact keeps a roster whose value is that a name on it answers when called; the prize is the roster and it cannot be split because a standing order assumes an answer. She is not on the roster, has not been paid a stipend, and has never been asked to teach the discipline either, and both of those are answers.

It is a discipline of Bankers rather than a school of thought, its teachers are disliked socially and consulted constantly, and nobody teaches a technique they have not personally survived. It is the only body of teaching in the setting that would accept her as a student rather than as an asset, and accepting her would close her. She has read its literature, which is one-page drills copied by hand, and knows more of it than anyone who has not lit.

The body path is the branch every emberblood household teaches and the branch on which her species is fastest, so her line's entire pedagogy points at exactly the thing that ends her. She has cleared two gates of it and stopped inside a year, which is faster than her line's practice and considerably slower than its expectation, and there is no authored ordinal for her species anywhere, so nothing above those two gates exists to be tempted by.

A famine of a settlement-sized population whose dosage tables stopped being a schedule and became a supply, and whose practical arithmetic was made in bodies rather than in measures. An emberblood on a span measured in decades is the population for whom that arithmetic is most exact and least survivable, and her house holds tables nobody has needed to update because nobody in it has ever been old.

reference_stats.summary: The fastest body in the setting with the slowest record of spending it, in a species whose entire social position rests on one irreversible act she has not performed and will not be pressed into. Nothing about her capability is in question. Nothing about her timing is anybody's to influence.
strengths: refines qi faster than any other body in the record, and has never spent any of it, so nothing about the rate has decayed
reads intent at the speed of a struck match, which is structural in the species and costs her nothing to keep
the only emberblood in the setting whose mind path is still open, because the path closes at the moment of lighting and she has not lit
a furnace that has never been spent and therefore has never been closed, which makes her the only body here whose future is still undecided
weaknesses: a lifespan measured in decades rather than centuries, so every year of deliberation is subtracted from a total that was already short
no elemental law seated beneath her to spend a furnace into, so overflow has nowhere to go but flesh that cannot be repaired
four gates clear and no authored ordinal above them, which means there is no ladder for her to be tempted by and none for her line to point at
her standing with her household depends entirely on the one act she has declined, so her place in it is contingent and revocable
deliberately under-uses the one faculty of her species that costs nothing, because using it visibly reads as lighting
reference_stats.combat_read: Fight her as though it is the only one there will be, because on her species it is, and know at the same time that she is likely to have spent almost nothing on herself and be the least practised fast body anyone has met. Her quick reading is free and untrained and she will beat most people before she is hurt. She will not be there for the second exchange: not because she is unwilling, but because her body has no repair budget behind the rate and she has never been given a reason to start one.
notes: Every advantage is paired with an authored cost and the pairing is anatomical and institutional together: the rate and the short span are the same clause of the species summary, and the open mind path is the direct consequence of not having lit. The whole is one condition rather than a strong fighter with a weakness, which is the condition the species record itself states as a single fact. Nothing has been added for her.

Her species carries no authored ordinal anywhere in the setting and no ceiling mechanism that states one, so the realm field reports the two gates she has cleared and the absence of anything above them rather than inventing a rung. Existing records handle the same absence the same way and this is deliberately consistent with them.

The cinder famine is named in her relationships because the record states that its practical arithmetic was made in bodies rather than measures. It is not asserted here that her lifespan is short in the ordinary sense or that she is at risk from it, and no mechanical rule about emberblood susceptibility has been invented: the pairing is the species summary's own two clauses and nothing further.
